swe_cat = {
	swe_cheap = {
		allowed = { tag = SWE }
		visible = { has_country_flag = swe_open }
		available = { has_war = no OR = { is_in_faction = no num_of_factories > 5 } }
		cost = 25
		days_remove = 30
		days_re_enable = 60
		complete_effect = { add_stability = 0.01 }
		remove_effect = { add_war_support = 0.01 }
	}
	swe_once = {
		fire_only_once = yes
		available = { has_government = democratic }
		complete_effect = { add_political_power = 10 }
	}
	swe_var_cost = {
		cost = swe_cost_var
		complete_effect = { add_stability = 0.02 }
	}
	swe_mission = {
		days_mission_timeout = 90
		activation = { always = no }
		timeout_effect = { add_stability = -0.1 }
	}
	swe_spacer = {
		available = { always = no }
		complete_effect = { custom_effect_tooltip = swe_spacer_tt }
	}
	swe_no_effect = {
		available = { has_war = no }
	}
	swe_quoted = {
		available = { has_dlc = "Man the Guns" }
		complete_effect = { add_stability = 0.01 }
	}
}
